text:
The themes of solitude and the human need for connection in "The Lighthouse Keeper" can be interpreted through various lenses. For readers who value independence, the protagonist’s introspection may represent a noble pursuit of self-discovery and peace. Conversely, those who prioritize community might view the isolation as a source of suffering, emphasizing the critical role of social bonds in mental well-being. The arrival of the sailor serves as a catalyst, highlighting that even those who seek solitude are not entirely immune to the pull of human interaction.
